ownership.quote: Web Browsing for AI with privacy you can trust, backed by Mozilla.

stage.quote: I joined Mozilla to lead New Products, where I've had the good fortune of supporting the development of meaningful new Mozilla tools like Solo, Tabstack, 0DIN, and an enterprise version of Firefox.
stage.note: Tabstack is a product built internally within Mozilla Corporation's New Products / Pioneers group, not an independently funded startup; it has no separate funding rounds. No accelerator/incubator batch found beyond internal Mozilla 'Pioneers' program, which is not an external accelerator with a public cohort page, so left empty.

note: Tabstack is a product of Mozilla Corporation, built and launched under Mozilla's 'New Products'/'Pioneers' initiative alongside other tools like Solo and 0DIN. It is not an independently incorporated or separately funded startup, so funding-round and standalone-revenue fields are not applicable/unknown; treat it as a subsidiary product line of Mozilla for buyer due-diligence purposes.
